Metadata.title: Torino City Intelligence
Metadata.description: Interactive map of Turin with POI layers and a 0-100 per-zone score answering "where to open a café".

Map.basemapError: Could not load the basemap. Data layers may still be available.
Map.emptyHint: Enable a layer to see points on the map.

Scoring.title: Zone score
Scoring.noZone: Click a zone on the map to see its breakdown.
Scoring.mapEmpty: All layers are off — enable a layer to see points on the map.
Scoring.intro: Each of Turin's 94 statistical zones gets a 0-100 score from five weighted variables. Lower café density scores better; the rest score better the higher their value.

cafe.name: Café competition
cafe.desc: Inverse of café density in the zone. Fewer competitors → higher score.

traffic.name: Potential traffic
traffic.desc: POI density and land-use mix as a proxy for foot traffic.

transit.name: Transit access
transit.desc: Transit stops within 500 m of the zone centroid.

flow.name: Daytime flow
flow.desc: Schools and shops as a proxy for daytime visitors.
